correctness.rationale: Averaging an arbitrary admissible quadratic form with its pullback under the coordinate swap preserves its comparison bounds, so an optimum may be taken as \(Q_\rho=u^2+\rho v^2\). The two norm branches reduce to the displayed one-variable ratios. Three fixed directions force \(M_\rho/m_\rho\ge2^{5/3}/3\) on the two sides of \(\rho=3/2\). At \(\rho=3/2\), the positive-branch derivative has sign \(t(3t^2-1)\), and the negative-branch derivative reduces to the sign of \(\sqrt{1-s^2}-1/2\), giving global minimum \(3/2^{4/3}\) and maximum \(2^{1/3}\) on both branches. Their ratio is exactly \(2^{5/3}/3\). A fresh symbolic derivative check independently reproduced the positive-branch critical factor; the bundled dense numerical verifier only supplements the analytic extrema.
